nodes.label: Hydraulic pressure drop
nodes.description: Measured pressure is below the configured 260 bar threshold.

nodes.label: High oil temperature
nodes.description: Measured oil temperature is above the configured 50 C threshold.

nodes.label: Vibration spike
nodes.description: Measured vibration exceeds the configured 4.5 mm/s threshold.

nodes.label: Hydraulic seal or hose leak
nodes.description: Possible component hypothesis when pressure drops; must be verified by inspection.

nodes.label: Relief valve or hydraulic pump
nodes.description: Possible pressure-control component to assess using approved procedure.

nodes.label: Oil cooling system
nodes.description: Cooling airflow and heat-exchange path associated with elevated oil temperature.

nodes.label: Oil level and condition
nodes.description: Oil level, contamination and viscosity are possible factors for high temperature.

nodes.label: Bearing, alignment or mountings
nodes.description: Possible mechanical factors associated with vibration; not a confirmed root cause.

nodes.label: Synthetic incident 024: pressure loss with vibration
nodes.description: Synthetic example in which pressure loss and vibration increased together; not evidence that a present event has the same cause.

nodes.label: Hydraulic inspection checklist
nodes.description: Check alarms, fluid level and visible external leaks after following approved isolation and lockout procedures.

nodes.label: Thermal and lubrication checks
nodes.description: Review cooling, oil condition and operating load against manufacturer limits.

nodes.label: Vibration inspection checklist
nodes.description: Compare baseline trends and inspect mounting points only after energy isolation.

nodes.label: Safe isolation and escalation
nodes.description: Follow site lockout/tagout and approved procedures; a qualified engineer verifies any diagnosis.
